To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The nucleon is not a three-constituent-quark system; 2) The strange quark is a sea quark, not a constituent; 3) The nucleon magnetic moment is not saturated by the three constituent quarks; and 4) Chiral symmetry is essential for a correct description of the nucleon.
